subject: Maths
title: Multiplying decimals
subtitle: Decimals — All Operations · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can multiply decimal numbers using place value and the column method.

key_vocab.definition: To multiply decimals, ignore the decimal points, multiply as whole numbers, then put the point back using the total number of decimal places.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can multiply decimal numbers using place value and the column method.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: multiply decimals -- To multiply decimals, ignore the decimal points, multiply as whole numbers, then put the point back using the total number of decimal places.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Multiply as whole numbers, then place the decimal point so the answer has the correct total number of decimal places.
1.2 × 0.3: 12 × 3 = 36 → 0.36
2 decimal places in total

Key examples:
  ✓ 0.3 × 0.4 = 0.12  (1 d.p. + 1 d.p. = 2 d.p.)
  ✓ 2.5 × 4 = 10.0  (1 d.p. + 0 d.p. = 1 d.p.)
  ✓ 1.2 × 0.3 = 0.36  (12 × 3 = 36, 2 d.p.)
  ✗ 0.3 × 0.4 = 1.2  (wrong number of d.p.)
  ✗ 2.5 × 4 = 100  (forgot the decimal point)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – decimal by whole number
  Calculate 3.4 × 5
  Ignore decimal: 34 × 5 = 170
  Total d.p. in question: 1
  Place point: 17.0
  = 17.0
  (One decimal place in the question means one in the answer.)

Example 2 – decimal by decimal
  Calculate 0.6 × 0.7
  Ignore decimals: 6 × 7 = 42
  Total d.p.: 1 + 1 = 2
  Place point: 0.42
  = 0.42
  (Two decimal places total: answer is 0.42 not 4.2.)

sections.title: Harder multiplications
sections.content:
Work as whole numbers first, then place the point.

(a) 2.4 × 1.3
(b) 3.5 × 2.6
(c) 4.2 × 0.15
(d) 0.08 × 0.6

sections.title: Word problems
sections.content:
Multiply to find the answer.

(a) Petrol costs £1.45/litre. Cost of 8 litres?
(b) A tile is 0.3 m × 0.3 m. What is its area?
(c) Speed 4.5 km/h for 2.5 hours. Distance?
(d) 3 items at £2.99 each. Total?

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ 0.3 × 0.4 = 0.12 (2 d.p.)
✗ 0.3 × 0.4 = 1.2
✓ Total d.p. in answer = sum of d.p. in question
✗ Multiplying decimals always gives a bigger number
✓ 2.5 × 4 = 10
